overlap.scope: SSE first/last arrival intersection; chunks are not token boundaries or GPU occupancy.

whole_batch.definition: Sum of final API completion_tokens / (last request end - first request start). Includes small-prompt admission, TTFT, decoding and terminal drain. Not decode-only engine TPS.

correctness.note: Cancelled streams compare the shorter content/reasoning prefix; equal cancellation length is not required. Complete requests require identical prompt/completion/total token counts; cache and other usage metadata differences are shown as qualifications, not output mismatches.

mixed100k.scope: Matched finite normal requests with fixed bodies/max budgets and exact actual output hashes, finish reasons and three logical usage counts, including natural EOS. No unequal-work speedup comparison. Silence is SSE arrival gap, not token TBT. prompt_ms includes engine prompt stage. Whole-case rate includes admission and final drain. No automatic deployment/performance pass.

prefill.note: No automatic speed/deployment verdict. Negative latency change is faster; positive throughput change is faster.
